Planning a kitchen remodel in San Antonio? Start with one question: will the sink and the range stay where they are? If they do, your remodel is mostly a cabinet and countertop job, and that is usually the best value. Moving water, gas or walls brings in more trades, more permits and more weeks. Our new kitchen remodel guide walks through the cabinet-first way: 1. Who does what. On a full-service install, our own crews tear out and haul away the old cabinets, then level, scribe and hang the new ones and install the countertops and hardware. Plumbing, electrical, flooring and paint stay with licensed trades or your contractor. 2. What it costs. A 10x10 cabinet package starts at $1,750 (cabinets only), and every estimate is free and itemized. 3. How long it takes. Most projects run about 1 to 3 weeks from order to install. Shaker White, Shaker Gray and Navy Blue are in stock, and the rest of our 36 finishes arrive in 1 to 2 weeks. 4. Which City of San Antonio permits apply, and which don't. Installs in the greater San Antonio area carry a 3-year workmanship warranty. Active-duty military and veterans save 25% on the whole invoice. Design, in-home measuring and estimates are free. Visit our family-owned showroom at 5601 Bandera Rd, Suite 100, or ask us to measure your kitchen at home. Pictured: white Shaker cabinets with a contrasting island, from our project gallery. I reached out to Dave on facebook, on a far reaching hope that I could hire them to help me move.  No contracting work, but I needed muscle.  To my surprise, they said yes!!.  In a move that I anticipated to take 2 days, it only took 4 hours.  These guys are worth it.  Thanx again Dave!!
